visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Stack Object Instead of a Loose Array and Index
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A global array and a manual top index implement the stack. Wrap them in a Stack constructor with push, pop, peek and isEmpty. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The array and its top position are kept together and updated only by the methods, so the index cannot get out of step with the contents.
